pokedexEntries.bk: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

pokedexEntries.wh: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

pokedexEntries.y: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

pokedexEntries.as: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

pokedexEntries.sh: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
